UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated WALLX user profile synced after Google Sign-In.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the signed-in user.

displayName.description: User's display name from Google Sign-In (1-100 chars).

email.description: Optional user email address (PII, owner-only read).

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on profile creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on sign-in or profile sync.

AppRelease.title: AppRelease
AppRelease.description: Latest WALLX app release metadata published by the app owner for live in-app update checks.

versionCode.description: Monotonic Android versionCode (1-100000) compared against BuildConfig.VERSION_CODE.

versionName.description: Human-readable release version string (1-32 chars, e.g. 1.1).

releaseNotes.description: Summary of what is new in this release (1-500 chars).

downloadUrl.description: Optional HTTPS update download or store URL (up to 2048 chars).

forceUpdate.description: Whether the update prompt requires updating before continuing.

updatedBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the app owner who published this release.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() when published.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-isolated user profile documents containing display name, avatar URL, and email PII.

/app_config/{docId}.description: App-wide release configuration (docId: latest_release) readable by signed-in users and writable strictly by the verified app owner.
